## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For API/provider changes, include mocked request and error cases; for storage/concurrency changes, include the relevant database or recovery checks. For documentation changes, check links and examples; for workflows, include actionlint and relevant CI results.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe API/configuration changes, migrations for both storage engines, and deployment or rollback steps when relevant. Write “None” if there are no operational changes.

- [ ] Relevant documentation and the changelog are updated.
- [ ] Examples and diagnostics use fake data and contain no credentials.
- [ ] Validation covers the changed behavior.
